title: Underwater UFO cases back to the 1800s

tellings.quote:
he just released a book
about UFOs in the water,
underwater UFOs, and his cases go back to the
1800s.

plain: Reports of UFOs in and under the sea go back to the 1800s, according to a book by the UFO historian Richard Dolan. The scientist Kevin Knuth mentions it to Michels, saying Dolan "just released a book about UFOs in the water, underwater UFOs, and his cases go back to the 1800s," though he does not name the book or describe any of the cases.
